{"metadata":{"description":"不要让 Model 为确定性问题反复思考，也不要让 Harness 为不确定的问题假装知道答案","id":"gh:1352597754","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-runtime","slug":"goatliamia/dsh-runtime","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","runtime"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"不要让 Model 为确定性问题反复思考，也不要让 Harness 为不确定的问题假装知道答案"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Runtime"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Let the model do the thinking; let the Harness handle what can be determined.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`dsh-runtime` is a set of small Runtime capabilities for the DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It does not try to build a new Agent, and it does not try to teach the model everything through more"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" prompts, skills, or rules."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"It handles one class of problems:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **Problems the model should not keep guessing about, because the Harness can already determine the"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Problems the model should not keep guessing about, because the Harness can already determine them.**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"For example:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"* May this action run right now?
* Did the last step actually change anything?

> Did the user actually approve?"},{"id":"p62s1","text":"If the Harness can determine these, the model should not have to remember a piece of text."},{"id":"p63s1","text":"A simple principle:"},{"id":"p64s1","text":"> **Things that need understanding go to the model.**

>
> **Things that cannot be confirmed are admitted as unknown.**"},{"id":"p65s1","text":"# Finally: why a Plugin?"},{"id":"p66s1","text":"Because we do not claim to know what the final structure of an Agent should be."},{"id":"p67s1","text":"This project only observed one very concrete fact:"},{"id":"p68s1","text":"> **In real Agent runs, some work is already deterministic enough that it should not keep occupying "},{"id":"p68s2","text":"the model's reasoning space.**"},{"id":"p69s1","text":"If that work can be separated out, the most natural way is not to push it all back into Core."},{"id":"p70s1","text":"Instead:"},{"id":"p71s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p72s1","text":"Today it may be Runtime."},{"id":"p73s1","text":"Tomorrow it may be something else."},{"id":"p74s1","text":"There is no need to know in advance."}],"truncated":true}
